description: A parametric hinge model of reinforced concrete coupling beams for collapse assessment and performance-based design of coupled wall structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Kuanshi Zhong, University of Cincinnati (uc.edu). Archived in this data depot is the digital appendix of the manuscript titled as "A parametric hinge model of reinforced concrete coupling beams for collapse assessment and performance-based design of coupled wall structures". Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: reinforced concrete, coupling beam, hinge model, collapse assessment, nonlinear response history analysis. Published 2025-04-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
